WINTER THEME
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43580864/997c32bfa6d24f4c65ad95e6a1227749b41946ca.png
Each new area has a winter theme! Treasure chests are now presents, enemies are turned Christmas colors, snow falls, Kan and other NPCs can be seen wearing Christmas hats! Bosses are also Christmas themed! If you would like to turn this setting off, all you have to do, is turn it off by unchecking the box in the pause menu. 

QUALITY OF LIFE FEATURES
Skippable Cutscenes, simply press Spacebar during any cutscene to skip!
Adjusted Sound Volume on Sawblades
Adjusted Sound Volume on Acid Pits
Title Screen will now remember your settings for Fullscreen and volume!
Powerups will immediately go into your inventory upon picking them up, when before, you had to walk into them.

BUG FIXES
Max Speed Stat Changed: (.5, 2)  → (.1, 2.5)
Fixed Game Crashing Bug with the GlitchRaptor (The Irony)
Fixed Certain Item Unlocks Displaying Incorrectly
Fixed Crystal Blocks in Ruins so that they sometimes spawn with trapped DeathDactyls

notes.title: Patch 2.5
notes.notes:
Patch 2.5
MAJOR BUG FIXES

 Riptide Story Progression Fixed
 Bone Boots not activating breaking platforms Fixed
 Fixed enemies attacks being triggered by gold coins
 Fixed arrows sticking to magnetized gold coins


MINOR BUG FIXES

 Kan's Ghost Form was not displaying properly, and now it correctly displays
 Fixed issue where player was able to shoot during some cutscenes
 Fixed issue where Eye of Wild negated King Midas coin drops
 Fixed Issue where gold coins could trigger door and take player to next level
 Fixed ghost enemies not disappearing when modifying HP in the Warrior Altar
 Fixed Enemy Death Animations spawning behind foliage
 Slightly Increased Hitbox of Hive Flies
 Slightly Tweaked Statue Hitboxes to help avoid getting stuck
 Tweaked collision priority on Frog Tongue to help avoid bugs with player getting pulled through / into walls
 Fixed issues where spear trap statues could push you into the ground
 Fixed issue where Gold Bars, BloodGems, and Hearts as well as Rotating Celestial Bodies around Kan were silhouetted in the Temple.
 Fixed bug where Tezcatlipoca Mask did not remove effect of Tlaloc Idol
 Adjusted Sound Radius on SawBlades
 Fixed Temple Fire Trap stopping bullets during flame burst
 You can now shoot under Crystals in ruins, and they will fall


QOL FIXES

 New Game is option is back, but warns you before overwriting save file.
 Totems in the 4th area now have sound effects
 Added SFX for Floor Switches and Door Openings
 Added SFX for Falling Boulders
 Added shading to fishing hole to better blend in with environment
 Added shading FX to water during fishing mini game
 Changed Quetzalcoatl Boss Artwork to better align with in-game boss


Moving Forward
Hello everyone! This patch seeks to address some of the most persistent and game breaking bugs. It addresses roughly 90% of all bugs sent in my discord, which as a side note, THANK YOU to everyone for sending in suggestions and bug reports in the discord! I am transitioning back into full time game dev, and I appreciate and am grateful for the patience from this community. Looking forward into the future, expect a substantial update before Christmas, that will vastly improve and rework many systems, enemies, and bosses in the game. After Christmas, work on the Realm of Mictlan content update will begin! Please join the discord if you have not already, and be a part of this amazing community! Enjoy the game everyone!
-Matthew

ACHIEVEMENTS
I radically adjusted the time it takes to unlock certain achievements, and significantly reduced the conditions that needed to be met. This should improve game balance, game feel, and allow players to fully all the items and combos this game has to offer. Below is an attached image on how to unlock each Achievement. Some are purposefully still left vague. 

QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES
Added in nameplates above NPC dialogue boxes
Reduced Number of Levels Needed to Progress through Saurian City by 2
Reduced Number of Levels Needed to Progress through Temple by 4
Start button will no longer appear if you have a save file. This should help avoid accidental save overwrites.
Removed annoying saws in 5th level areas. (you know the level)
Made shops appear later on in areas, as well as slightly increased shop prices.
Made fishing slightly faster.
Made the catch pull up animation for fishing twice as fast.


BUG FIXES
Fixed a Bug where Attack Speed Slot 3 in Skill Tree was not updating correctly
Fixed a Bug where Crit Chance Slot bugged out, and did not let player keep purchased Crit Chance Upgrades
Fixed Music not stopping after Gorgos Fight
Fixed Bugs with Enemies spawning in Ground in 4th Area Level
Fixed Armored Raptor Mask Falling too slowly
Fixed bug where Gorgos cinematic was displaying incorrectly
Fixed Progression Bug w/ Gorgos Saying the wrong lines
Fixed Cannon NPC Progression Bug where Purchasing the Autograph did not progress the story
Fixed bug where Anime Maid Skin was not unselecting. 
Fixed camera issues in 5th area temple levels.
Removed some platforms in 5th area, not respawning.
Fixed the achievement Stay Hard! Should be properly working now.
Fixed a bug with harder versions of Yax, He now properly turns into a crystal form when going invulnverable and will do so more than once a fight.
Fixed bug where players could not shoot up against walls with eye of magic.
Fixed bug where plant spawns in 2nd boss fight were dropping loot.
Slightly Adjusted 2nd area terrain so that GUI elements do not cover up enemy spawners.
Fixed graphical issue with Bleed.
Made it so you cannot activate fishing multiple times while fishing.
Twin fish meat did not properly appear in inventory

KNOWN BUGS
Achievements on Linux Operating Systems do not currently work
Sometimes coins fall into the ground (Godot Physics Engine Bug, Very Little I can do Here)
Damaging effects such as poison, bleed, etc. do not visually update, and occasionally bug out boss Hp bars.
Midas Ring Bugs HP Bars
Tezcatlipoca Mask does not remove all effects sometimes
Enemies attack gold
Multitudes of other small (and large) bugs in the discord, huge thank you to the community for catching them.

Thanks so much everyone for the amazing feedback, the game will continue to grow and receive updates moving forward! I am hoping to focus on bug fixes and hopefully fully complete controller / steamdeck support in the coming weeks. And if you haven't already left a review for the game, it would mean the world! It directly supports and pushes this game out to more people!

-Matthew
